config_settings.label: Username
config_settings.description: Primary BIG-IP account. Used for iControl REST and SSH in 'Shared credentials' mode, for REST only in 'Separate' mode, and for SSH in 'SSH only' mode unless an SSH username is given below.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.userName
config_settings.label: Username
config_settings.description: Enter the BIG-IP username. Same role as the direct-input username above.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.password
config_settings.label: Password
config_settings.description: Enter the PAM vault reference that contains the password for the username above.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.authMode
config_settings.label: Authentication mode
config_settings.description: How the credentials map onto the BIG-IP. 'Shared credentials' (default) uses the username/password above for both iControl REST and SSH. 'Separate REST and SSH credentials' uses the username/password above for REST and the SSH username/password below for SSH (for example admin for the API and root for the CLI). 'SSH only' skips REST entirely and uses the username/password above for SSH, or the SSH username/password below when both are set. All lifecycle operations run over SSH; REST is only used by Test Connection. RADIUS/TACACS/LDAP accounts are entered as a normal username/password; the plugin handles both Advanced shell and tmsh terminal access.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.sshUserName
config_settings.label: SSH username
config_settings.description: SSH login used for all lifecycle operations when the authentication mode is 'Separate REST and SSH credentials' (required) or 'SSH only' (optional, falls back to the username above). Ignored in 'Shared credentials' mode.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.sshPassword
config_settings.label: SSH password
config_settings.description: Password for the SSH username. Same rules as the SSH username.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.sshPassword
config_settings.label: SSH password
config_settings.description: PAM vault reference that contains the password for the SSH username. Same rules as the SSH username.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.sshPort
config_settings.label: SSH port
config_settings.description: SSH port on the management address. Leave blank for 22.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.clientSslProfileMode
config_settings.label: Client-ssl profile handling
config_settings.description: How the client-ssl profile bound to the virtual server is handled when a certificate is renewed. 'Update existing profile' (default) replaces the certificate, key and chain inside the profile that is already bound, so profile names and all other settings stay as they are. 'Create new profile' copies the bound profile to a new one named after the new key, binds the copy and unbinds the original.

config_settings.name: config_attributes.updateServerSslProfile
config_settings.label: Update server-ssl profiles
config_settings.description: When the virtual server also has a server-ssl profile (re-encryption to pool members) that presents the certificate being replaced, repoint it to the new certificate in the same transaction as the client-ssl profile. 'Yes' (default) keeps both sides in step; 'No' leaves server-ssl profiles untouched. server-ssl profiles carrying a different certificate are never modified.

fields.name: config_attributes.group_sync_enabled
fields.label: Enable HA group sync
fields.description: Enable this option to trigger a config-sync to the sync-failover device group after a CSR is generated and after a certificate is installed. Only applicable to HA pairs; on a standalone BIG-IP the setting is ignored.
